events.did: sat with Dani on the Slope of Lockland University, set his coffee down and cracked his knuckles
events.quote_anchor: Victor set the coffee down and cracked his knuckles.

events.did: made a student holding books drop them by twitching his fingers, then held her and her companion kneeling
events.quote_anchor: His fingers twitched, and so did hers, the books tumbling to the ground.

events.did: held the joggers on the quad, taking hold of four, then six, then ten players
events.quote_anchor: his focus sharpened on the players, as he took hold of four, then six, then ten.

events.did: called out “Stop” and cut through the humming static, making Victor let go
events.quote_anchor: Dani’s voice cut through the humming static, and Victor let go, the brief discomfort in his chest retreating as he did.

events.did: showed Victor the tablet readings of his straining heart and losing pulse rhythm
events.quote_anchor: Dani showed him the readings on the screen, the way his heart began to strain, his pulse not climbing as an athlete’s would, but losing rhythm.

events.did: asked Dani for a refill by handing her the empty cartridge
events.quote_anchor: “I need a refill,” he said, handing her the cartridge.

events.did: explained the empty vial was a suppressant and a stimulant and told him to listen to his body

events.did: dropped the coffee cup into a trash can as he and Dani walked on
events.quote_anchor: They passed a trash can, and Victor let the coffee cup drop into the dark.

relations.did: is the young scientist supplying Victor with a new compound and monitoring his vitals through a sensor on his ribs
relations.quote_anchor: Beneath his shirt and coat, the monitor pressed between his ribs, its sensor feeding vitals to the tablet in real time.

relations.did: refused to make more than a week’s worth of the compound at a time and refused to show Victor the formula
relations.quote_anchor: Dani had refused to make more than a week’s worth at a time. Refused, as well, to show Victor the formula, claiming she was still refining it.

relations.did: was making herself invaluable so that Victor would need her and she would not become another body in his wake
relations.quote_anchor: She was making herself invaluable. So long as Victor needed Dani’s participation, she wouldn’t become another body in his wake.
